paragraphs: The F-Pace P400e is Jaguar's plug-in hybrid variant of the F-Pace SUV, introduced in 2020 as part of the X761 generation. The petrol engine is the Ingenium AJ200P - a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder - which works alongside an electric motor to produce 404PS combined. The P400e offers an electric-only range of 33 miles per Jaguar's own specification. The P400e sits alongside the rest of the F-Pace range as Jaguar's petrol PHEV offering, distinct from the diesel and supercharged V8 variants in the lineup. No PHEV-specific known issues have been confirmed for this variant at this time.

cards.body: A 2.0L I4 + electric motor (404PS combined, 33mi electric range) Petrol Plug-in Hybrid engine fitted to the F-Pace P400e - X761 (2020-present).
